title: Rory and the Meadow of Glowing Petals
verses:
As the moon rose up high over ridges of green,
Sweet Psittaco chirped from a canopy high.
A quiet blue meadow was waiting unseen,
Beneath the soft glow of the slumbering sky.

Big Benny walked slow with a heavy deep tread,
While Rory stepped soft with his tail sweeping low.
Sweet Tilly bent down where the clover was spread,
To watch how the petals were starting to glow.

As the petals closed down in the cool evening breeze,
They hummed a sweet song as they nodded their head.
Brave Ricky lay close to the roots of the trees,
And settled right down on a mossy green bed.

High up in the branches, sweet Nia swooped round,
Then folded her wings as she settled to rest.
Little Psittaco landed without any sound,
To cozy right down in her feathery nest.

Green Rory sighed softly and snuggled up near,
While resting his chin on a pillow of moss.
With friends all around him, he felt no more fear,
As moonlight dripped down like a velvety gloss.

The night was so peaceful, the forest was still,
Each eye fluttered shut as the breeze blew away.
Soft shadows leaned low over river and hill,
Safe dreaming until the return of the day.
